generations.title: POV unbag on chairlift
generations.prompt:
POV from a chairlift seat on a bright day, blue sky and snowy slopes below. Gloved hands pull the knitted ski mask from <<<image_1>>> out of a clear bag and hold it up to the camera so it fills a third of the frame, then stretch it to show the design. Gentle chairlift sway. Natural sound only: wind, lift cable creak. No music, no text.
A small American flag is visible in the background.

shot on iphone 12, no warm lighting, no blur, nothing cinematic, make it look as organic as possible, remove the caption and the emojis. when recreating do not make the video grainy or sharp in any way, remake it as if it was freshly refilmed 4k iphone 12 footage.
